acceptanceCriteria: The test asserts once-per-artifact derivation by a deterministic counter (or a load-independent bound) and passes under host contention.
The test still fails when derivation is repeated per call.
body: Observed by the corpusmcp lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1504): the test's 50 ms wall-clock bound failed once at 63 ms with host load average ~70. A once-per-artifact derivation property should be asserted by call count, not wall time.
